coverage.large: Three named arbitrary-subset constructors with r=81,81,243, each with actual exact capacity certificates. No range above 27 is asserted.
coverage.named: Five named full joint LP pairs, the frozen quarter and twelfth certificates, and an exact lifted full primal/dual at (r,a,p,q)=(9,4,1,1). No Q optimizer is used in this turn.
coverage.repair: Three non-power-of-three auxiliary orders 6,18,30 exercise positive beta repair mass. They are checks of the repair lemma, not claimed complete target ranges.
coverage.types: All 575 parameter tuples 6<=r<=10, 3<=a<=r-3, 0<=p<=a-1, 0<=q<=r-1; exact face criterion compared against both rational type LPs. Not all graph isomorphism classes.
